targets.old_statement: At a railroad crossing with a train coming you stop between 15 and 50 feet from the tracks, and the lower limit matters since trains overhang the rails by at least three feet.
targets.old_spoken_statement: At a railroad crossing with a train coming you stop between fifteen and fifty feet from the tracks, and the lower limit matters since trains overhang the rails by at least three feet.
targets.statement: When a train approaches a railroad crossing, all vehicles must stop between fifteen and fifty feet from the tracks, and trains overhang the rails by at least three feet on each side with cargo possibly extending farther.
